        Not verified on a unit: the menu item names below are from WTI's documents.
        Credentials: inherited from the default (tacctl config snmp), not set for scope 'lab'.
        /N [Enter]              Network Parameters
        <n> [Enter]             SNMP Parameters -- the item number varies by model/firmware;
                                pick the entry labelled "SNMP"
        Set each item (type the item number, [Enter], then the value):
          SNMPv3 User               : (NOT SET: tacctl scope snmp lab v3-user <user>)
          Location                  : Rack 4, DC1
          Contact                   : NOC <noc@example.net>

        Client restriction (not verified on a unit): the udp port 161 lines of the IP Tables list (Step 5) are
          the restriction: they accept SNMP only from the clients below and the final DROP (last step) refuses
          the rest. If the unit has an SNMP access menu of its own, enter the same clients there instead.
          allow  10.0.0.42/32
          allow  198.51.100.0/24
          refuse 0.0.0.0/0 (everything else)
          Check from the tacctl server: tacctl scope snmp lab test <device-address>   (expects sysName 'core-sw1')

Unfilled SNMP values: v3 user (tacctl scope snmp lab v3-user <user>)
